reviews.text:
My cat was constipated, and I was so grateful for their help.

The doctor was very friendly and easy to talk to, and explained everything thoroughly.

All the staff were also very kind.

I was so worried about what would happen to my cat, so I was very relieved.

I don't know the going rate for the bill, so I can't say if it was expensive or cheap, but it was within my expectations, which was good.

The detailed breakdown of each item was very helpful.

Afterward, my cat had a bowel movement, recovered, and is now healthy again.

Thank you so much!

Dear Maro Moriyama,
Thank you for always visiting our clinic.
We are very pleased to receive such a high rating from you.
We will continue to strive to ensure that you and your dog can visit our clinic with peace of mind.
The very kind Dr. Fukunaga, the director and the staff

They're open on weekends, which is very helpful. 
Appointments can be made and confirmed via LINE or email, which is very convenient. 

The doctors and staff are all very friendly, and it's a very clean hospital where I can feel safe and comfortable. ^_^

They've also been very helpful in taking care of my beloved dog. 
Thank you for your continued support.

I am so so grateful for this veterinarian. I have brought my cat to see them multiple times, and they always treat him with the utmost care. Even though I don't speak Japanese, the staff always take the time to translate everything for me and explain the medicine and treatment so I understand everything. Thank you so much for taking such good care of marshmallow 🐈

Mr. Shiki Naruyasu
Thank you very much for visiting our clinic.
We are very pleased that you were satisfied with our services.
All of our staff look forward to your next visit, Mr. Shiki.

For over 20 years, I have entrusted the healthcare of my beloved family members to this clinic with complete peace of mind.

My first visit was when my previous cat was diagnosed with breast cancer in her later years. Another hospital had given her only a month to live, but I refused to give up. A friend recommended this clinic, and I went there desperately hoping for a solution. The head veterinarian kindly and powerfully encouraged me, saying, "There are still things we can do! Let's do our best!" True to his word, he provided various treatments and palliative care. As a result, I was able to spend nearly a year with my beloved cat, and then peacefully say goodbye at home. I am still incredibly grateful.

Currently, I confidently entrust my dog ​​and cat with their regular health checkups and treatments. My 15-year-old dog was diagnosed with a chronic illness a few years ago when a small heart abnormality was found during a health checkup. Thanks to careful observation and medication, the disease hasn't progressed, and he's still running around happily today.

Furthermore, if you have any concerns about pet care, the doctors, nurses, and other staff members are all kind and attentive, and will listen to your questions.

The clinic is neat and clean, with tasteful interior design that evokes a Scandinavian atmosphere. Cute little items are displayed each season.

They were quick to adopt medical equipment such as plasma and lasers, and offer treatments at reasonable prices, showing their genuine desire to help animals in any way they can.

This is a very reassuring, reliable, and enjoyable animal hospital to visit!

Dear Shigeru Moriyama,
Thank you for always visiting our clinic.
We are very happy to hear that you are satisfied with our services.
All of our staff will continue to work hard.

We have been receiving great care from this clinic for over 10 years, ever since he was a puppy.
The doctor is very thorough, and it is easy to ask questions and seek advice, so I feel at ease when I go there.
Since he turned 10, I have been going to the clinic more often, and it is reassuring that the clinic is only closed on very few days except for the New Year holidays.
The staff are also very kind.

All the doctors, including the director, examine patients with kindness and care. They explain treatment details clearly and are very trustworthy. Not only the doctors but also the staff are considerate and considerate of any anxieties you may have, making this a very comfortable animal hospital. As a sincere hospital that treats both pets and owners with warmth, I would definitely recommend Monarch Animal Hospital to anyone in the neighborhood who has just started keeping a pet.

It's a small animal hospital, but the explanations were thorough and reassuring, and the fees seemed reasonable. The receptionist was also very kind and friendly, which eased my anxiety.
I even met someone who had driven three hours to get there.
They seem to have a dedicated parking lot, and they showed me a map, but it looked difficult to understand, so the coin parking lot on the other side of the road might be a better option.

I received a vaccine and a PIDI (Patient-Induced Diabetes Test)!

The doctor was very nice, and the explanation was easy to understand.

We have been using Monarch Animal Hospital since it first opened. They treat our animals with genuine care, putting themselves in the owner's shoes and the animals' needs.

We are also grateful for the thoughtfulness of the staff.

If you wish to visit, we recommend making an appointment.

This is an excellent animal hospital that provides accurate diagnoses and treatments, and considers not only the animals but also their owners.

The director and all the staff are very kind people.
The doctors and reception staff were all very kind, and I felt at ease entrusting my precious family member to their care. This is truly a trustworthy hospital.

My one-and-a-half-year-old hamster had an appetite, but he was eating poorly and getting increasingly thinner, which seemed to be a pain. I could see dogs, cats, and rabbits, but I couldn't find a hospital that would properly treat hamsters, so I went here as a last resort after hearing good reviews.
It turned out to be the right decision.
I deeply regret having almost given up because of his age.
There are three doctors on staff, but on that day there was only one doctor on staff and he was busy.
They carefully checked every inch of his little body, and provided accurate treatment without any unnecessary tests or treatments. Now he's strong enough to drive the car to the store.
Incidentally, our hamster wouldn't chew on chew sticks or treats, but his teeth had grown too long, causing pain inside his mouth and getting in the way, preventing him from eating or drinking water.

I've had several hamsters before, and this was my first time seeing a case like this, so I was surprised, but after cutting his teeth and giving him an IV drip, he quickly recovered, making him look completely different.

The initial consultation fee was 2,500 yen, the IV drip 1,000 yen, and each tooth cut cost 1,000 yen - all very reasonable prices. The doctor was very kind and explained things carefully, treating animals with kindness, so I would definitely recommend this hospital to anyone looking for a hospital for illnesses in small animals, as well as dogs and cats!

This is truly the worst hospital.

I went for my first appointment. Initially, I was told that reservations were required by phone, so I made one. However, my preferred time slot was fully booked, so I chose a different time.

When I arrived on time, the male receptionist was incredibly rude. I don't know if it was because it was my first visit, but he glared at me.

He spoke to me while sitting in his chair, never looking at me, and repeatedly made me stand up.

Despite having a reservation, I was made to wait for 40 minutes without a single word of acknowledgment.

At that time, I could hear two staff members chatting and laughing from the back room. If they had time to do that, couldn't they have at least told me how much longer the wait was?

What's the point of making a reservation if you're going to wait this long?

Ultimately, my turn never came, so I had no choice but to go home without seeing a doctor.

I've been to many hospitals before, but this was the worst I've ever experienced.

I will never forget this hospital.
